name: Wifi connection failures
description: Reviewers report the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality seems poor.

name: Login and password failures
description: Reviewers say the app won't let them into their account or accepts their password, alongside complaints about too many ads.

name: Premium cost concerns
description: Reviewers feel the app has shifted toward paid premium mainly to generate revenue for the company.

name: Features locked behind premium
description: Reviewers say basic actions like choosing songs, skipping, or replaying sections now require a premium subscription.

name: Missing songs and genres
description: Reviewers note that many songs are absent from the library and certain music genres, such as gospel, are thin.

name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
description: Reviewers report lyrics sometimes fail to display or are available for some songs but not others.

name: Weaker song recommendations
description: Reviewers feel recommendations used to offer more songs and newer releases than they do now.

name: Downloads get stuck
description: Reviewers report song downloads stalling indefinitely in the background without completing.

name: Offline playback broken
description: Reviewers say the app does not play music correctly when offline.

name: General negative sentiment
description: Reviewers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, often citing a recent update, without specifying a particular problem.

name: App crashes after update
description: Reviewers report the app crashes or cannot open following a recent update.

name: General playback malfunctions
description: Reviewers report songs not playing, repeat and section-play failing, voice assistant not starting playback, and audio adjustment bugs.

name: Stuck on loading screen
description: Reviewers report the app hangs on the loading or logo screen and does not proceed.

name: Playback stops unexpectedly
description: Reviewers say music stops halfway through a track and does not resume where it left off, starting a different song instead.

name: Too many or loud ads
description: Reviewers complain of frequent, loud advertisements interrupting songs, especially for users without premium.

name: Home screen layout disliked
description: Reviewers dislike the new home screen, which shows one playlist, album, or artist at a time in a scrolling feed.

name: Shuffle and skip limitations
description: Reviewers complain playlists play in random order, songs cannot be chosen directly, and skips are capped, making listening frustrating.

name: Requests for feature tweaks
description: Reviewers praise a feature such as Blend but request enhancements like renaming Blends.
